antes.bogoshorts-2026: Raj’in (We Shall Return) is an immersive documentary capturing the ongoing ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in the West Bank by settler militias and Israeli authorities. Filmed over the last three years, the cinematic experience follows the displacement of over 20 communities, with three protagonists bearing witness to the systematic, daily violence. The film weaves 360º footage, placing viewers inside a vanishing Palestinian landscape, and phone footage recording events on the ground,unfiltered.
